retrieval.compatibility: benchmark adapter task semantics and minimum matching features
retrieval.rank: matching features desc, then newest first
retrieval.scope: records of the same task family only

reuse.dedupe: programs equal after stripping blank lines and trailing whitespace count once
reuse.rank: best matching features among the program's success records desc, then its best measured speedup desc
reuse.requires: a success record (passed, every sample faster than the baseline) that stores the full program
reuse.skip: a program with a no-gain or failure record that matches the current workload on more features than any of its successes

upgrade_rule.description: start with the small model; switch to the large model for the rest of the run, if model requests remain, after 2 consecutive candidate attempts that are not correct-and-on-target or after 3 small-model requests without an on-target candidate
